notes.en: Odette is primarily played as an off-field support in Stellar-Glimmer teams. She casts her Elemental Skill, follows up with its second cast to activate her Solo Dance Double's Stellar Glimmer attacks, and then swaps off-field. While off-field, her Solo Dance Double continuously deals Cryo and Stellar Glimmer damage every 2s, maintains consistent Cryo application, and enables Stellar-Conduct or Stellar-Swirl for the on-field character. Odette requires very little field time outside of refreshing her Skill, making her an excellent enabler for teammates that demand extended on-field presence. Her Elemental Burst is generally used when available for its additional damage and utility but is secondary to maintaining Skill uptime and the Solo Dance Double.
